# zone Provider

The Zone.EU provider manages DNS records on the Zone.EU hosting platform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "zone" {
  username = var.zone_username
  api_key  = var.zone_api_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) The API key used to authenticate with Zone.EU API. Can also be set via the ZONE_EU_API_KEY environment variable.
- `username` (String) The ZoneID username used to authenticate with Zone.EU API. Can also be set via the ZONE_EU_USERNAME environment variable.
